checks.evidence: 'इस खोज से कोई एजेंट मेल नहीं खाता।' parses as oblique PP (इस खोज से) + subject (कोई एजेंट, masc sg) + negated habitual verb (मेल नहीं खाता); the idiom 'X से मेल खाना' = 'to match X' is standard, and कोई+singular noun+singular verb is the natural Hindi negative-polarity form. No copula is needed in the present habitual, matching the shipped frame. Final danda per the hi style guide's punctuation rule; no ?, no !, standard conjunct spellings, no ZWJ/ZWNJ, single spaces.
